spans.s: दुःख [duḥkha], a. [दुष्टानि खानि यस्मिन्, दुष्टं खनति खन्-ड, दुःख्-अच् वा Tv.]
Painful, disagreeable, unpleasant; सिंहानां निनदा दुःखाः श्रोतुं दुःखमतो वनम् Rām.
खम् Sorrow, grief, unhappiness, distress, pain, agony; सुखं हि दुःखान्यनुभूय शोभते
; अर्थानामर्जने दुःखमर्जितानां च रक्षणे । आये दुःखं व्यये दुःखं धिगर्थाः कष्टसंश्रयाः ॥
. (दुःखम् and दुःखेन are used as adverbs in the sense of 'hardly' 'with difficulty' 'or trouble' Ś.7.13. अव्यक्ता हि गतिर्दुःखं देहवद्भिरवाप्यते
). -Comp. -अतीत a. freed from pain. -अन्तः final emancipation. -आर्त, -अन्वित a. pained, afflicted, distressed. -कर a. painful, troublesome, -गतम् adversity, calamity;
. -ग्रामः 'the scene of suffering', worldly existence. -छिन्न a.
pained, distressed. -च्छेद्य also दुःखो- च्छेद्य a.
to be conquered with difficulty. प्रजानुरागाद्धर्माच्च दुःखोच्छेद्यो हि धार्मिकः
. -जात a. feeling pain. -जीविन् a. living in pain or distress;
. -त्रयाभिघातः unbearable association of the three sufferings; दुःखत्रयाभिघाताज्जिज्ञासा Sāṅ.
. -दुःखम् (instr.) with great difficulty; (धारयन्ती) शय्योत्सङ्गे निहित- मसकृद्दुःखदुःखेन गात्रम्
. -दुःखिन् a. having sorrow upon sorrow; मया रक्षति दुःखदुःखी
.-दोह्या (a cow) difficult to be milked. -प्राय, बहुल a. full of trouble or grief. -भागिन्, -भाज् a. unhappy.
. भोगः occurrence of trouble or misery. -योगः infliction of pain; Ms. -लव्य a. hard to be pierced or cut; B.
. -लोकः worldly life, the world as a scene of constant suffering. -शील a.
hard to please or manage, bad tempered, irritable; उपेत्य सा दोहददुःख- शीलताम्
accustomed to the misery of; कामेकपत्नीव्रतदुःखशीलाम्
; 'who is accustomed to (suffer) the misery (hard lot) of a perfectly chaste life. -संचार a.
impassable -सागरः 'the sea of troubles'; worldly life.
दुःखायते [duḥkhāyatē], Den. Ā. To feel pain, be distressed. (Also दुःख्यति Den. P.)
Distressed, afflicted, pained; दुःखिता यत्र दृश्येरन् विकृताः पापकारिणः
दुःखीयति [duḥkhīyati], Den. P. To suffer pain, be distressed; दुःखीयति सुखहेतोः को मूढः सेवकादन्यः
दुःख् [duḥkh], 1 U. (दुःखयति-ते) To pain, afflict, distress.
